symbols.name: deletion_initiated
symbols.description: A Property Owner has initiated the property deletion process

symbols.name: confirmation_prompted
symbols.description: The Platform displays a prompt asking for confirmation of the deletion

symbols.name: deletion_confirmed
symbols.description: The Property Owner has confirmed the deletion

symbols.name: property_record_removed
symbols.description: The Property record is removed from the Platform's active data set

symbols.name: property_deleted
symbols.description: The deletion process for the Property has been completed

symbols.name: confirmation_message_displayed
symbols.description: The Platform displays a message confirming the deletion

symbols.name: redirected_to_properties_list
symbols.description: The user is redirected to the properties list view

symbols.name: property_record_retained_in_db
symbols.description: The Property record remains present in the database

symbols.name: property_hidden_from_ui
symbols.description: The Property is not visible in the user interface

symbols.name: deletion_attempted
symbols.description: A Property Owner has attempted to delete a Property

symbols.name: property_belongs_to_user
symbols.description: The Property being deleted is associated with the User Account of the actor

symbols.name: deletion_denied
symbols.description: The Platform rejects the deletion request

symbols.name: authorization_error_displayed
symbols.description: The Platform displays an error message indicating an authorization failure

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner initiates property deletion, THE Platform SHALL prompt for confirmation before proceeding
rules.reading: Whenever a Property Owner initiates the property deletion process, the Platform must display a confirmation prompt.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner confirms deletion, THE Platform SHALL remove the Property record from the Platform
rules.reading: If a Property Owner confirms the deletion, the Platform must remove the Property record from its active data set.

rules.text: WHEN a Property is deleted, THE Platform SHALL display a confirmation message and redirect to the properties list
rules.reading: In any situation where a Property has been deleted, the Platform must display a confirmation message and redirect the user to the properties list view.

rules.text: THE Platform SHALL implement soft deletion to retain Property records in the database for audit purposes while hiding them from the user interface
rules.reading: The Platform must ensure that Property records are retained in the database while being hidden from the user interface to support soft deletion for audit purposes.

alternative.reading: When the deletion process for a Property is completed, the Property record must remain in the database and be hidden from the user interface.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner attempts to delete a Property that does not belong to their User Account, THE Platform SHALL deny the deletion and display an authorization error message
rules.reading: If a Property Owner attempts to delete a Property that is not associated with their User Account, the Platform must reject the deletion request and display an authorization error message.
